description: This file contains utility functions, class definitions, and data structures for managing and analyzing module statistics, memory tracking, runtime estimation, and graph construction related to distributed training in PyTorch, specifically for optimizing SAC and FSDP configurations.

classes.name: ModOrder
classes.description: TypedDict representing the order of modules in forward and backward passes.

classes.name: ModRuntime
classes.description: TypedDict for storing forward and backward runtime of a module.

classes.name: ModStats
classes.description: TypedDict containing detailed statistics for a module, including memory, runtime, and tradeoff info.

classes.name: ModuleInfo
classes.description: TypedDict aggregating module order and list of module statistics.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Class representing a node in the module graph, extending ModStats with index and position.

classes.name: Graph
classes.description: Class representing a directed graph of modules with adjacency matrix and node management.

methods.name: aggregate_stats
methods.description: Collects memory, runtime, and tradeoff statistics for each module in a model.

methods.name: parse_module_info
methods.description: Creates a graph structure from module statistics for optimization purposes.

methods.name: get_peak_memory_runtime_baseline
methods.description: Calculates baseline peak memory and runtime without FSDP or AC.
